major_risks.risk: Demand for the company's products and services is cyclical and highly sensitive to global and regional economic conditions, commodity prices and infrastructure, construction and housing activity.
Catastrophic events, including natural disasters, pandemics, cyber-attacks and war, could disrupt the company's workforce, systems, production and distribution.
Commodity price increases, supplier problems, supply chain disruptions and labor or material shortages could raise costs or prevent the company from meeting customer commitments.

limits: The read_statement tool did not return the income statement directly. I took it from Statement 1 using read_section, and the figures agree with the MD&A.

I did not read the full long-term debt note. A search found no finance-lease amount inside the debt captions, so total_financial_debt uses the balance-sheet borrowings without adjustment. The analyst should confirm this.
Interest expense uses only the 'Interest expense excluding Financial Products' line (502). Financial Products interest expense (1,359) is inside operating costs.

Total debt of 43,330 includes Financial Products borrowings of 32,617 (5,514, 7,085 and 20,018), which fund customer finance receivables. Leverage ratios therefore mix industrial and financial-services debt.
The January 2026 medium-term note issuance of 1.75 billion dollars affected the classification of current debt at year-end. The balance-sheet figures are used as printed.
The page numbers given are those visible in the report. The first-page figures for risk factors come from the first page of Item 1A only.
